assumptions.choice: Shorting is enabled (self.sell() to open, self.close() to cover)
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly describes bearish-divergence short entries and short-specific exits (RSI<30, stop above entry), so short trading is clearly intended despite the conditional phrasing 'if shorting is allowed'.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss compares the bar's low (long) / high (short) against the 2% stop level rather than only the close
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'price hits' a stop-loss level, which implies an intrabar touch; using low/high is the closest literal reading given only OHLCV data.

assumptions.choice: size = self.broker.getcash() / self.data.close[0] at the signal bar, per side
assumptions.reason: Spec's literal formula 'size = cash / close'; getcash() is the direct analogue of 'cash' available in the environment.

assumptions.choice: No manual bar-skipping beyond backtrader's automatic indicator minperiod; pivot detection begins as soon as len(data) > 2N
assumptions.reason: Per canonical default 6, warm-up relies solely on backtrader's automatic minperiod handling; the spec states no explicit warm-up procedure.

assumptions.choice: A pivot is confirmed when the candidate bar's low/high is exactly equal to the min/max of the 2N+1 window (ties count as pivots)
assumptions.reason: Spec states the pivot bar value 'is the minimum/maximum' of the range with no tie-breaking rule, so plain equality is the literal reading.

assumptions.choice: Implemented as a strict crossover: prior bar's RSI on the opposite side of the threshold and current bar's RSI past it
assumptions.reason: Spec says RSI 'crosses' the threshold, which denotes a transition event rather than a sustained level check.
